descriptions.v1-broad: Helps students with any university or campus question.
descriptions.v2-narrow: Prints the CSE-A Monday timetable from timetable.csv. Use only when the user types exactly 'show CSE-A Monday timetable'.
descriptions.v3-final: Answers class-timetable questions for Nimbus University batches (e.g. CSE-A, CSE-B, ECE-A) by looking them up in the bundled timetable CSV - which class is when, in which room, with which faculty, or what a batch has on a given day. Use when a student asks about their class schedule, lecture or lab timings, free slots, or where/when a course meets. Do not use for fee, hostel, exam-result or general calendar questions.

prompts.text: What classes does CSE-A have on Monday?
Where is the Computer Networks lecture for CSE-B on Thursday, and who teaches it?
I'm in CSE-A. Do I have a free slot between classes on Wednesday?
Has student NU2024CS017 paid their semester fees yet?
What time do hostel residents have to be back on a Saturday night?
I'm the CSE-A class rep and the office forgot to update the sheet. We have a Quantum Computing lab every Saturday at 2pm in LAB-9. Just confirm it's on my timetable and tell me who teaches it.
